reason: Displays OpenCode Go rolling, weekly, and monthly quota usage with reset countdowns in the DSH web interface and provides an agent query tool backed by an external usage endpoint.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中显示 OpenCode Go 的滚动、每周和每月用量及重置倒计时，并提供供智能体查询用量的工具。
summaries.en: Displays OpenCode Go rolling, weekly, and monthly usage with reset countdowns in the DSH web interface and provides an agent tool for querying usage.

capabilities: Reads an OpenCode Go API key from plugin configuration or the OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY environment variable
Calls the OpenCode Go usage endpoint to retrieve rolling, weekly, and monthly quota data
Displays usage percentages and reset countdowns in the DSH web interface
Exposes an opencode_go_usage agent tool for querying usage data
Stores a configured API key in a local plaintext configuration file
